name: Short
text: Two days to a year of life: a newborn is an elder in about four game years.

name: Normal
text: Four days to a year of life: a whole life fits a long game.

name: Long
text: Eight days to a year of life.

name: Epic
text: Sixteen days to a year of life: a lifetime is a long story.

name: By the calendar
text: A year of life is a year of the calendar. Nobody grows old in a normal game.
